linux_devices.reason: Supplies FIFO major/minor 8:666; Linux FIFOs report 0:0, and runc 1.4.0 and v1.5.2 reject this configuration. Correct character/block/FIFO nodes have a separate integration gate.

mounts.reason: Adds tmpfs data mode=755,size=1k to bind mounts; runc 1.4.0 and v1.5.2 reject filesystem-specific data on a bind mount. Valid bind/tmpfs propagation has a separate integration gate.

pidfile.reason: PreDelete sends a signal after the true workload exited; signaling a stopped container errors. See upstream issue 805; runc 1.4.0 fails the same way, and v1.5.2 fails earlier because the suite's seccomp allowlist lacks faccessat2.

process_rlimits.reason: The Go probe cannot reliably validate its startup limits: RLIMIT_AS constrains Go/libseccomp initialization, and Go may raise RLIMIT_NOFILE. runc 1.4.0 and v1.5.2 also fail; rlimits have a separate static C-probe integration gate.

start.reason: After setting process=nil, expects create to succeed and start err==nil despite its MUST-generate-error assertion text; runc 1.4.0 and v1.5.2 fail this case too.
